title: North Carolina's 13th Congressional District election, 2026
description: The 2026 general election for U.S. House in North Carolina's 13th Congressional District features incumbent Republican Rep. Brad Knott, who first won the seat in 2024, facing Democratic nominee Paul Barringer, Green Party candidate Anthony Aguilar, and Libertarian candidate Steven Swinton. The 13th district covers parts of Wake, Johnston, Lee, Harnett, Franklin, Caswell, Person, and Granville counties in the Raleigh exurbs. The Cook Political Report rates the race as 'Solid R,' and Knott's strong primary performance (89.9%) suggests a favorable path to re-election. The primary contests were held on March 3, 2026, with Knott and Barringer winning their respective party nominations.
polling_note: No public general election polling was found for this race. The Cook Political Report rates the race as 'Solid R' based on the district's partisan voting index.

candidates.name: Brad Knott
candidates.summary: Brad Knott is the incumbent Republican U.S. Representative for North Carolina's 13th Congressional District, first elected in 2024. A former federal prosecutor in the Eastern District of North Carolina (2016–2023), Knott serves on the House Judiciary, Homeland Security, and Transportation and Infrastructure Committees. He identifies as pro-life, supports Second Amendment rights, and focuses on border security and immigration enforcement.

candidates.name: Paul Barringer
candidates.summary: Paul Barringer is the Democratic nominee for U.S. House in North Carolina's 13th Congressional District, having won the Democratic primary on March 3, 2026, with 59.1% of the vote. He is a healthcare consultant, attorney, and Lee County native who manages his family's tree farm. Barringer emphasizes practical solutions rooted in constitutional principles, fiscal responsibility, and local control, and has worked pro bono representing individuals with disabilities in Social Security benefit claims.

candidates.name: Anthony Aguilar
candidates.summary: Anthony Aguilar is the Green Party candidate for U.S. House in North Carolina's 13th Congressional District. He is a retired U.S. Army veteran with 25 years of service and nine combat tours, and has been described as a whistleblower regarding the Gaza Humanitarian Fund. Aguilar's campaign emphasizes anti-war, pro-worker, and anti-corruption positions.

candidates.summary: Steven Swinton is the Libertarian Party candidate for U.S. House in North Carolina's 13th Congressional District, having advanced from the Libertarian primary without opposition. He previously ran as the Libertarian nominee for North Carolina State Senate District 19 in 2024. Swinton is a businessman who has been active in Libertarian Party politics in North Carolina.

forecast.rationale: No public general-election polling exists for this race, so the forecast relies entirely on non-polling indicators. Those indicators point overwhelmingly to Republican retention: (1) Incumbent Rep. Brad Knott already holds the seat after winning it in 2024 and won his 2026 GOP primary with 89.9% of the vote. (2) Cook Political Report rates the district 'Solid R,' reflecting its strongly Republican partisan lean across Raleigh-exurb counties. (3) The district's composition (parts of Wake, Johnston, Lee, Harnett, Franklin, Caswell, Person, and Granville counties) is exurban and leans right. (4) Democrat Paul Barringer is a credible nominee, but no polling or other contrary evidence in the race file suggests the seat is competitive. (5) Third-party candidates (Green and Libertarian) are on the ballot but are not favored to win. Without polling, confidence is medium despite the strong structural indicators.
